text:
Before the meal: two fried eggs, half an avocado, and a small cup of espresso or coffee with crema.

Eggs: two large fried eggs weigh about 92 g in total and carry roughly 90 kcal each with oil, so about 185 kcal.

Avocado: half an avocado looks like roughly 100 g (the photo shows a half without the pit, maybe slightly smaller). That is about 160 kcal. At 90 g it would be about 145 kcal, so I take about 150 kcal.

Coffee: an espresso or small coffee adds about 2 kcal and roughly 30-60 g of liquid. The cup looks empty afterward, so it was all consumed.

After the meal: the plate is nearly clean, with only smears left, so almost everything was eaten.

Totals: about 185 + 150 + 2 ≈ 337 kcal. Mass is about 90 g of egg + 90 g of avocado + 40 g of coffee = 220 g.
